digest.component_or_area: ticket store convergence and reader cache self-healing
propositions: Runtime marker files (*/.archived, */.write.lock) are committed in the tickets branch HEAD despite gitignore patterns, causing git status to report dirty state and breaking plan-review attestations that require clean HEAD.
The ensure unit untrack-runtime-markers removes tracked marker files from the index via git rm --cached in batches, leaving worktree copies untouched, then commits once to converge store state.

Reader self-healing in reducer._api.py re-materializes a missing .archived marker when a ticket's compiled state indicates archived, restoring the fast-path cache on peers that merge the untrack commit.
The two-clone merge test validates that the untrack commit merges cleanly into a diverged peer, git deletes the peer's worktree markers, and status remains clean afterward.
Marker cache behavior remains unchanged on the running machine and derived correctly from source-of-truth (ARCHIVED events for archival, fcntl handles for write.lock).
The ensure unit is idempotent: running it twice makes zero commits on the second invocation and reports no action needed.
